Name: Chronal Disruption
Components: M, S (metal dust from a cog)
Description: You target a target creature within range to plunge outside their timestream for a moment, causing them to feel like they were prickled by pins. The target must pass a Constitution Saving Throw or suffer 3d6 bludgeoning damage, 4 Tremor and lose your choice between their next Bonus Action or Reaction, or only suffering half that damage and Tremor count on a success.
At Higher Levels: For each Spell Slot Level spent above 2nd you deal an additional 1d6 of Bludgeoning damage and an additional count of Tremor, which is rounded down on a successful Saving Throw.
